gloss: Carries two accounts of Badr: Umar's, of the Prophet's supplication for help before the angels arrived, and Ibn Abbas's, of the deliberation afterwards over what should be done with the captives.

_note: NEEDS_SCHOLAR_REVIEW — the isnad of this report has NOT been examined. It is entered as `ungraded` on purpose and must not be regraded without a scholar's verification. The edge that cites it (8:17 -> battle-of-badr in links.json) is held at `draft` and is not published; see that record and the README.
_collectionNote: collection is `ahmad`, not `other`. The enum does carry a Musnad Ahmad value — see hadithRefSchema.js. `number` is the volume/page locator of the cited edition rather than a hadith number, because no edition-stable number was supplied and Musnad Ahmad's numbering differs between editions.

gradings.source: Musnad Ahmad, vol. 1, p. 368; also in Ibn Hisham's Sira, vol. 1, p. 668

gloss: Reports that during the fighting the Prophet took up a handful of dust and flung it toward the ranks of the Quraysh, with the words that their faces be scorched.
